tasks.sql: SELECT file_id,descriptor,opcode_count FROM methods WHERE class_descriptor='Lcom/bapis/bilibili/main/community/reply/v1/Content;' AND name IN ('getUrls','getUrlsMap') AND param_count=0 AND return_descriptor='Ljava/util/Map;' AND method_kind IS NOT NULL AND opcode_count>0 ORDER BY file_id,method_idx

SELECT file_id,class_descriptor AS descriptor,count(*) AS matching_members FROM methods WHERE method_kind IS NOT NULL AND opcode_count>0 AND name IN ('getMessage','getUrlsMap') AND param_count=0 GROUP BY file_id,class_descriptor HAVING sum(CASE WHEN name='getMessage' AND return_descriptor='Ljava/lang/String;' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 AND sum(CASE WHEN name='getUrlsMap' AND return_descriptor='Ljava/util/Map;' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 ORDER BY file_id,class_descriptor

SELECT file_id,descriptor,superclass_descriptor,interface_count FROM classes WHERE descriptor LIKE 'Lkntr/common/comment/%/model/%' AND instr(descriptor,'RichText')>0 AND instr(descriptor,'$')=0 ORDER BY file_id,descriptor

SELECT min(c.file_id) AS file_id,m.return_descriptor AS descriptor,count(DISTINCT c.file_id) AS source_dex_count FROM method_calls c JOIN methods m ON c.file_id=m.file_id AND c.method_idx=m.method_idx WHERE c.callee='Lcom/bapis/bilibili/main/community/reply/v1/Content;->getUrlsMap()Ljava/util/Map;' AND m.return_descriptor LIKE 'L%' AND m.return_descriptor NOT IN ('Ljava/util/Map;','Ljava/lang/Object;','Ljava/lang/String;') GROUP BY m.return_descriptor ORDER BY m.return_descriptor

WITH targets AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.return_descriptor AS descriptor FROM method_calls c JOIN methods m ON c.file_id=m.file_id AND c.method_idx=m.method_idx WHERE c.callee='Lcom/bapis/bilibili/main/community/reply/v1/Content;->getUrlsMap()Ljava/util/Map;' AND m.return_descriptor LIKE 'L%' AND m.return_descriptor NOT IN ('Ljava/util/Map;','Ljava/lang/Object;','Ljava/lang/String;')) SELECT cf.file_id,cf.class_descriptor AS descriptor,count(*) AS field_count,group_concat(f.descriptor,char(10) ORDER BY cf.field_idx) AS field_layout FROM class_fields cf JOIN fields f ON cf.file_id=f.file_id AND cf.field_idx=f.field_idx JOIN targets t ON cf.class_descriptor=t.descriptor GROUP BY cf.file_id,cf.class_descriptor ORDER BY cf.class_descriptor,cf.file_id
